subject: Re: Project Sirocco kickoff: CFQ as a first-class eval product
body:
Baseline status for Sirocco.

Reproduced on our harness: Universal Transformer at 18.7 MCD-MEAN and Transformer at 17.9 — both inside the published confidence intervals, so the harness is trustworthy. T5-11B run finished Sunday: 41.3 MCD-MEAN vs the published 40.9 +/- 4.3, again in range. MCD1 remains much easier than MCD2/MCD3 (61.8 vs ~31), same pattern as the paper.

One thing to note for the leaderboard copy: the published SOTA is HPD at 67.3 +/- 4.1, and we have NOT reproduced it — it's a specialized architecture and 3 weeks wasn't enough. Proposal: leaderboard launches with reproduced-by-us badges on our four baselines, external numbers marked as reported. Keeps us honest.

Compute note: Titan preemption cost us ~4 days total, tolerable, no Vulcan ask needed.

Hyun
